"""Resolve git conflicts by taking one side (feature branch = stage 3 = the commit being replayed)."""
import sys, re

    """Take the >>>>>>> (feature branch being replayed) side of every conflict."""
    result = []

    in_base = False  # True = we're in the HEAD/upstream side, False = feature branch side
    for line in content.split('\n'):

        if in_conflict and in_base:

        result.append(line)
    return '\n'.join(result)
